name: HeroPickUp
_intent: The villain arrives at the food and picks it up, unhurried and heavy: the lead (right) foot plants, the trailing foot steps back into a split stance, then he bends with weight (knees give, back leans, rear heel peels up, the left arm hangs heavy) while staring at the food; the right fist comes down onto the top of the food just in front of the right foot and closes on it (Grab); he rises slowly, bringing it up to shoulder height out to his right and turning his head to study it (Lift); then a confident beat: chest up, head cocked, food held steady (Hold), held.
_reference: walk-to-stop, split-stance pick-up of a heavy object (hip and knee hinge, braced hand), slow rise, presenting / inspecting the object at face height; held last pose

keyframes._note: HeroStalk pose at its RIGHT heel strike (t=0.2667)
GRAB: knuckles close on the food
LIFT: the food up at the face, studied

_grip.weld_C0: CFrame.new(0, -(0.15 + radius), 0) on RightHand = CFrame.new(0, -1.05, 0) for the authored 0.9 food (the knuckle face points along the hand's -Y)
